content:
Implementation of Phase 38 (Gatekeeper Pre-checks, 3.2.0) on branch `phase-38-gatekeeper-pre-checks` — commits d90c067 + 5af49e8. Full suite: 1084 passed, 5 skipped.

WHAT LANDED (per the approved plan, sections A–J):
- `tagteam/gatekeeper.py` (new): `GateSpec`/`resolve_gatekeeper`/`load_spec`; checks in the fixed order scope (FROZEN first) → plan-doc → tests (`_run_command`: shell string / list, stderr merged, `TAGTEAM_GATE=1`, process-group kill on timeout, tail = last `max_output_chars`, full output to `.tagteam/gates/<stem>.log`); `decide` (fail→BOUNCE; cap → `GATE: checks failed but bounce cap (N) reached — reviewer, see report` + PASS-WITH-FINDINGS line); `consecutive_bounces` (trailing GATE_BOUNCE among gate entries); `run_gate` = peek decided → slot-first claim (kind=gate; SlotBusy → `deferred`, no DB row) → locked sweep+claim (`db.claim_gate`, ≤2 attempts; refused → release slot and branch on the persisted decision / live-other / attempts-exhausted PASS-with-findings) → checks outside the lock → locked `cycle.ensure_gate_applied` + row finish in the same hold → slot released on every path (finally). `sweep_abandoned_gates` (reconcile-from-entry first, then dead pid / identity mismatch / timeout+grace without matching slot marker → abandoned; unverifiable kept + reported), `gate_status`, `last_gate_summary`, `gate_command` (check|run|status|list, --json).
- `cycle.py`: `ROLE_GATEKEEPER`, `GATE_PASS/GATE_BOUNCE`; `capture_impl_boundary` (HEAD sha + sha256 of every dirty/untracked path, `--untracked-files=all`) captured in `add_round` on a plan-cycle APPROVE (rulings go through add_round → covered), copied at impl init (`copied-from-plan`), read file-first via `read_impl_boundary`; `compute_impl_work` (rules a/b/c + artifact & plan-artifact exclusions, `ImplWorkUnavailable` → skip); `ensure_gate_applied` (entry-first idempotent under the writer lock: never a second entry per `gate_event`; PASS = rounds + shadow DB + export only, seq unchanged; BOUNCE = compare-and-apply on (phase,type,round,submission_seq): applied once with `applied_seq`, `already`, or `superseded`; a FRESH decision for a moved submission writes nothing); `read_rounds_file` (canonical file, all keys); renderers label `### Gatekeeper`.
- `db.py`: schema v8 — `gates` table + `uq_gates_running` / `uq_gates_decided`, `claim_gate` (BEGIN IMMEDIATE INSERT…SELECT WHERE NOT EXISTS decided/running AND max(attempt) < max_attempts), `finish_gate`/`update_gate`/`gates_for_event`/`decided_gate_for_event`/`gates_for_cycle`/`last_gate`/`running_gates`/`unfinished_gates`; `gates` in NON_FILE_BACKED_TABLES; `_ACTION_TO_STATUS` GATE_*; VALID_ROLES/ACTIONS widened.
- `config.py`: `GATEKEEPER_KEYS`, `validate_gatekeeper_config`, `get_gatekeeper_spec` (briefer pattern, unknown keys rejected).
- `watcher.py`: `_maybe_gate` at the `_handle_ready` seam for turn==reviewer in all four modes (PASS falls through to the existing hand-off in the same tick; BOUNCE returns; deferred/error/not-ready latch `_gate_owed_seq`; stale never dispatches); the same-seq branch of `tick()` re-enters `_dispatch` while the latch matches (pause respected); spec resolved in `_build_processor` (problems warn + disable); startup banner line.
- `headless.py`: `SLOT_KIND_GATE`. `cli.py`: `gate` dispatch + help. Cockpit: `now_payload.gatekeeper {enabled,on,last}`, feed kind `gate`/`gate bounce`, `chip-gate` in the Now strip. Docs: SKILL (both copies identical — line-61 delta reconciled; lead pre-flight + reviewer note), README "Gatekeeper" subsection + CLI ref, HTW `#gatekeeper` section + files table, roadmap. `pyproject.toml`/`CITATION.cff` → 3.2.0.
- Tests: `tests/test_gatekeeper.py` (96): config; boundary matrix (plan-only fails / code passes / impl-doc passes / unborn HEAD / dirty-unchanged → committed-identical → modified / deletion / untracked-dir growth / legacy skip / no-git skip); checks (scope frozen before a file-creating test command, truncation, timeout kill, log, pytest summary, list form); decide + cap; run_gate (pass/bounce/decided-not-rerun/not-applicable/not-ready/stale/slot-busy/live-other/superseded-on-AMEND/error/attempts-exhausted/cap/manual); ensure_gate_applied double-call no-ops; fault matrix (a)–(g); sweep matrix incl. concurrent reclaim; watcher: PASS same-tick hand-off + BOUNCE no-dispatch in notify/tmux/iterm2/headless, gate-owed latch busy→free on identical ticks in all four modes, pause interplay, restart mid-gate, disabled byte-identical, PASS write semantics across restart, contained gate error, `_build_processor`; CLI; cockpit payloads/assets; render labels; SKILL copies; flag-off full cycle. Plus `test_db.py` v8 (v7→v8 rebuild keeps ids, claim/attempt cap, uq_gates_decided, snapshot/restore) and `test_cockpit_api.py`.

DEVIATIONS FROM THE PLAN TEXT (recorded in the plan under "Implementation notes"): (1) v8 rebuilds `rounds` in place — same columns/ids/index — to widen the v1 `role IN ('lead','reviewer')` CHECK (the first dogfood tripped DB_INVALID on it); (2) `impl_boundary` lives on the status FILE only (no cycle column) and the gate's entry keys are read from the canonical JSONL (`read_rounds_file`), because the DB-first views drop them; the key is written only when non-null so flag-off status files stay byte-identical (parity corpus unchanged); (3) an AMEND (rounds-only, no seq bump) supersedes a decision through a pinned round-log length (`pre_entries`); the same event key re-runs as attempt 2; (4) `run_gate` treats a caller's older seq as `stale` and `not-ready` as no-dispatch; (5) no `verify_transition` GATE_BOUNCE branch needed (gate entries are role gatekeeper, never the verified agent's action).

DOGFOOD: real `tagteam watch --mode notify` on a scratch git project — round 1 (tests failing) → `GATE: BOUNCE`, `turn: lead`, `updated_by: Gatekeeper`, seq+1, reviewer NOT notified, lead notified next tick; fix + re-submit r2 → `GATE: PASS` in the same tick, reviewer notified, seq unchanged; `tagteam gate list` shows bounce (applied_seq=4) + pass. `tagteam gate check` exit 1/0 with the same report. This repo's own tagteam.yaml is NOT changed (plan: no auto-enable; and this phase's plan was approved before the boundary existed → scope would skip) — suggest enabling it for Phase 39+.

The implementation is broad and the focused suites pass (`145 passed`), but four recovery/cap gaps remain. I reproduced the first three directly against the submitted code.

1. **A crash after the BOUNCE cycle-status write but before top-level state derivation is misclassified as superseded and leaves split state.** `ensure_gate_applied()` handles (a) both stores reviewer-ready and (b) both stores lead-ready, but not the actual intermediate ordering used by the function: entry appended → cycle status written `ready_for=lead` → `_derive_top_level_state`. I injected that exact middle state and then called `ensure_gate_applied`; it returned `{'applied': 'superseded', 'seq': 3}`, leaving cycle status `ready_for=lead` while top-level state remained `turn=reviewer, seq=3`. The current fault test c only appends the entry while *both* status and state remain reviewer-ready, so it does not cover “after status write, before derive.” Recognize this partial-applied shape (same phase/type/round, top-level reviewer at `submission_seq`, cycle status lead for the gate entry), finish `_derive_top_level_state` exactly once, mirror/export, and record `applied_seq`. Add the precise injection point/test and assert top-level lead, seq+1, one entry, terminal bounce row.

2. **Recovered PASS does not repair a missing shadow-DB round or markdown export.** If the process dies immediately after the JSONL `f.write()` and before `_shadow_db_after_amend` / auto-export, the retry finds `existing`, sets `entry_appended=False`, and the PASS branch returns without invoking either helper. Reproduction: before reconciliation DB roles were `['lead']`; afterwards they were still `['lead']` even though canonical JSONL contained `GATE_PASS` and `ensure_gate_applied` reported pass. This breaks the promised cross-store “ensure applied” contract and can hide the gate entry from DB-first reviewer tails. On every recovered/existing PASS, idempotently ensure the canonical rounds are mirrored (the existing `_shadow_db_after_cycle_write` already dedupes by round/role/action/ts) and run auto-export, without deriving top-level state. Add a fault test that crashes immediately after JSONL append—not after a fully completed `ensure_gate_applied` call—and proves DB/render parity is restored.

3. **Superseded `GATE_BOUNCE` audit entries incorrectly consume the bounce cap.** Recovery intentionally retains the entry when its row becomes `superseded`, but `consecutive_bounces()` counts raw gate entries by action only. I reproduced a stale bounce entry reconciled to `gates.status='superseded'`; `consecutive_bounces()` still returned 1. Two such recovery races can therefore force PASS-with-findings without any applied bounce. Count only decisions whose gate row terminally applied as `bounce` (and let an applied `pass` reset the streak), or persist an unambiguous applied/superseded marker that the counter resolves. Add tests proving superseded bounce entries are ignored and only consecutive applied bounce rows reach `max_bounces`.

4. **`tagteam gate status` does not perform the approved sweep/reconciliation.** The plan specifies sweep before each claim and from `gate status/run`; `run` does it, but `gate_status()` only reads rows. A dead runner therefore remains displayed as `running` (and, because it is definitively dead rather than “unverifiable,” no diagnostic note is added), while a row with an existing decision entry is not reconciled. Invoke the owner-safe sweep before the status read (or narrow it to the CLI status path if the accessor must stay read-only), and test dead-row abandonment plus entry-first reconciliation through `tagteam gate status`.

The slot-first claim, pre-test scope freeze, implementation-boundary matrix, normal PASS/BOUNCE flow, watcher latch/mode integration, config/CLI/cockpit wiring, schema migration, docs, and flag-off path otherwise look sound. Fix these recovery semantics, rerun the focused and full suites, update findings, and resubmit.

Round 2 — all four recovery/cap findings fixed (commit on the branch; plan doc "Impl round 2" section). Focused: tests/test_gatekeeper.py 100 passed; full suite 1088 passed, 5 skipped.

1. Partial-apply shape (entry present + cycle status `ready_for: lead` + top-level still reviewer at `submission_seq`) — `ensure_gate_applied` now recognizes it (`partial`), finishes `_derive_top_level_state` exactly once (turn lead, seq+1, updated_by Gatekeeper), mirrors, exports, returns `applied` with `applied_seq`; a second call → `already`. New test `TestFaultMatrix.test_c2_mid_bounce_after_status_write_before_derive` injects exactly that state (entry appended, status rewritten to lead, state untouched) and asserts top-level lead, seq+1, one entry, terminal bounce row with applied_seq, DB mirror carries the entry.
2. Recovered / existing decisions repair the other stores — every `ensure_gate_applied` call that finds the entry (PASS, BOUNCE `already`, and the retained-entry `superseded` case) re-runs `_shadow_db_after_cycle_write` (dedupes by round/role/action/ts) and `_auto_export_cycle_md`; PASS still never derives state. New test `test_b2_pass_crash_right_after_jsonl_append_restores_parity`: crash right after the JSONL append (DB roles == ['lead']), sweep → row pass, DB roles == ['lead','gatekeeper'], `db.render_cycle == render_cycle_from_files`, seq unchanged, DB-first tail shows the entry, second recovery does not duplicate.
3. Bounce cap counts APPLIED bounces only — `consecutive_bounces(rounds, decided)` resolves each entry's `gate_event` to its terminal gate row (`bounce` counts, `pass` resets, `superseded`/`error`/`abandoned`/unknown ignored); `applied_bounce_streak()` feeds `decide` in both `run_gate` and `gate check`; `last_gate_summary` (cockpit chip) reports the last DECIDED entry. New test `test_superseded_bounce_entries_do_not_consume_the_cap`: two superseded audit entries → streak 0 (legacy by-action view would say 2) → the next failing submission BOUNCES; two applied bounces → cap → pass-with-findings; an applied pass resets; cockpit summary says pass.
4. `tagteam gate status|list` sweep first — `gate_status()` runs the owner-safe `sweep_abandoned_gates` (best-effort) before reading, so a dead runner's row shows `abandoned` and a running row whose decision entry exists is completed. While testing this I found and fixed a related reconciliation bug: `reconcile_row` matched the entry by event only, so an EARLIER abandoned attempt could be "completed" from a LATER attempt's entry (and the later one then hit `uq_gates_decided`); it now completes only the row the entry names (`gate_id`). New test `TestCli.test_status_sweeps_dead_rows_and_reconciles_from_entries` (dead row → abandoned via `status`; running row #2 + its entry → pass via `status`; rows == [abandoned, pass]).

No other behaviour changed; the flag-off path, schema, docs and CLI surface are as in round 1.

Approved. All four round-1 recovery/cap findings are resolved: split-state BOUNCE recovery completes exactly once; recovered decisions restore DB/export parity; bounce caps count only terminal applied decisions; and gate status/list sweep with attempt-pinned reconciliation. Verified with 149 focused tests and the full suite: 1088 passed, 5 skipped.
